concepts.name: Ring / Quiet
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity FTW energy app concept for a public design voting canvas. Create a landscape 1536x1024 presentation with TWO large straight-on complete iPhone screens side by side, thin unobtrusive phone edges, on a warm neutral background. Entire viewport visible, no cropping. Polished credible native iPhone interface, superb legible typography. All text strictly ENGLISH, decimal point for numbers, no Swedish. Each screen tiny 'Concept · Example data'. No robot, chatbot, chat bubbles, decorative tokens, leaves or generic AI widgets. This is a NEW design proposal inspired by the reference, not a replica. Avoid tiny dense text; let the main interaction and energy flows be visually clear. Home is the household load; the home battery is separate from the EV. There is ONE grid connection that imports OR exports at a given moment. Solar only supplies energy. L1/L2/L3 belong to the GRID if shown. Use physically consistent values. Title above phones: 'Ring / Quiet'. Reference role: preserve the navy-black ground, four glowing energy colors, home at center, rounded segmented circular ring and connections from the supplied user design. Evolve it into calm premium full app screens. LEFT overview: a beautifully proportioned restrained circular energy ring around '1.2 kW' and 'Home', solar top-left warm yellow '6.0 kW', home battery top-right amber '2.4 kW' 'Charging · 68%', grid bottom-left pink '0.6 kW' 'Exporting', car bottom-right lilac '1.8 kW' 'Charging · 62%'. Four arc segments precisely follow the ring, rounded ends, understated depth and bloom; NOT neon sci-fi. Lower part a single calm row 'Car ready by 07:00' and large legible soft next-hours price chart. Bottom tabs 'Now', 'Plan', 'History', 'Home'. RIGHT home battery detail: large matching amber arc around '68%', '9.5 / 14 kWh'; battery flow '2.4 kW from solar'; broad soft charging forecast shape beneath, label 'Stored for this evening', bottom same nav. Quiet, minimal, finished native product.
